text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: PagerDuty incident INC-8932 fired for service=production-inference (us-west-2) — error-rate > 5% over the last 2m. Priority: P1.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8932 created and routed to the inference rotation.

devin: taking this — acked in PD. I'm oncall and will run initial triage.

maria: thanks. any customer-facing impact yet?

devin: Grafana shows a sharp spike in 5xx and request timeout errors starting ~1915012200. Approx 12% of requests failing for the last 5 minutes. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

ben: which models/replicas? Could be a model pool issue.

devin: looks like the dedicated pool for gpt-7b-quant is showing high OOMs and rapid restarts. Running `redwoodctl pool status --region us-west-2` now.

ops-bot: `redwoodctl pool status --region us-west-2`
```
POOL	MODEL	READY	RESTARTS
gpt-7b-quant-pool	gpt-7b-quant	2/6	12
gpt-70b-pool	gpt-70b	8/8	0
```

carla: contacting AMs for AcmeCorp and Shoply — they reported errors a minute ago. will update.

sre-oncall: @devin if OOMs are that high, can we move traffic to gpt-70b-pool as fallback? costlier but restores availability quickly.

devin: planning to route small percentage to gpt-70b-pool and scale up gpt-7b-quant replicas. Applying emergency routing now: `redwoodctl route update --service inference --fallback gpt-70b-pool --weight 0.2`

ops-bot: `redwoodctl route update` succeeded. New fallback in place.

maria: nice. also enabling prefix/KV cache for hot routes to reduce token load: `redwoodctl cache enable --route /v1/generate`

pagerduty-bot: INC-8932 acknowledged by devin. Escalation paused.

ben: devin, any logs from one of the failing pods?

devin: grabbing logs: `kubectl logs inference-gpt-7b-quant-3 -n redwood --tail 200`

```
E0421 10:12:43.123 [WARN] kv-cache eviction triggered, mem=74% -> evicting 128MB
E0421 10:12:44.567 [ERROR] decode failed: allocation failed (cuda out of memory)
E0421 10:12:45.001 [INFO] restarting worker process
```

carla: looks like memory pressure after recent config change to `max_seq=4096` in pool config. Who applied that?

devin: that was a Tuesday change in the perf-tuning PR — @maria did we ramp that in prod?

maria: I rolled it out for longer contexts on gpt-7b-quant to reduce truncation for a customer test. I had a canary but must have missed the autoscale profile mismatch. My bad.

sre-oncall: mitigation checklist: 1) keep fallback routing live (done), 2) scale gpt-7b-quant replicas from 6 -> 12 (in progress), 3) revert max_seq to 2048 for that pool if scaling doesn't stabilize.

devin: scaling now: `redwoodctl pool scale gpt-7b-quant-pool --replicas 12`

ops-bot: scale request accepted, pods launching.

maria: prepping rollback PR to change `max_seq=2048` and will hold until we see stable metrics.

ben: any customer impact estimate? SLA windows?

carla: AcmeCorp reported failed requests for ~3 minutes, Shoply for ~5 minutes. Account teams notified. Potential impact: degraded throughput for premium accounts — ramped fallback should mitigate remaining window.

devin: current telemetry: error-rate down to 1.8% after routing fallback + scaling started. Latency slightly increased for some requests on fallback (~120ms extra).

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8932 status: acknowledged -> mitigation in progress.

sre-oncall: If scale completes and error-rate stays <1%, we can move to postmortem. Keep me posted every 5m.

devin: will ping updates. Next check in 5m.

(5m later)

devin: scale completed. `redwoodctl pool status` shows gpt-7b-quant-pool at 10/12 ready, restarts dropping. Error-rate 0.6% over last 2m.

maria: rolling back max_seq to 2048 via PR and will coordinate a controlled rollout later with autoscale adjustments.

carla: AMs confirmed that AcmeCorp and Shoply are recovered and will follow up.

devin: preparing incident notes. We'll keep fallback for 30m to ensure stability then remove.

pagerduty-bot: INC-8932 changed status -> monitoring. If it remains stable for 30m we will resolve and file postmortem.

sre-oncall: thanks team. Assigning follow-ups: ACTION-1: maria to revert max_seq and add autoscale constraints. ACTION-2: infra to add an alert for rapid restart spikes per pool. ACTION-3: product to inform customers (carla).

carla: noted and will send a short customer-facing blurb after postmortem.

devin: closing loop here — will update thread with the postmortem link once ready. :thumbsup:
